links.outcome: Perceived adequacy of prior AI training and institutional training resources among dental professionals
links.effect: Adequate previous AI training mean 3.06 and institutional training resources mean 3.10, versus support for further AI training mean 4.13; AI awareness and training was the lowest construct (3.45).
links.quote: Participants strongly supported further AI training (mean = 4.13), despite lower ratings for adequate previous AI training (mean = 3.06) and institutional training resources (mean = 3.10).

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of dental healthcare professionals assessing perceptions, organizational readiness, training, and barriers to AI adoption in dental healthcare institutions.
